rawFindings.title: Possible runtime error accessing 'buckets' Map in 'files' getter
rawFindings.explanation: The 'files' getter accesses 'this.buckets.get(p.pattern)' without null or undefined check (removed '|| []' fallback). If 'buckets' Map does not contain 'p.pattern', this returns undefined, and passing undefined to 'from' causes a TypeError.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the fallback to empty array for safe iteration, changing back to 'from(this.buckets.get(p.pattern) || [])'.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: When a pattern key is missing in 'buckets', 'this.files' getter throws a TypeError: from() called on undefined.

rawFindings.title: 'PromiseContainer.then' method does not handle error callback correctly
rawFindings.explanation: Changed 'PromiseContainer.then' method from 'return promise.then(success).catch(error)' to 'return promise.then(success, error)'. The original code caught errors and called 'error' callback but this is non-standard. The 'then' method's second argument is the standard way to handle errors, so the new code is correct. However, if the provided 'error' callback expects to be called only on rejection, this change is actually a fix to make error handling correct.
rawFindings.suggestion: No action needed; the change fixes the method to use proper promise error handling.
